thread.title: Apple’s Pricey iPhone X Still Sold Better Than Any Other Phone - Barron's

author: Tiernan Ray
title: Apple’s Pricey iPhone X Still Sold Better Than Any Other Phone - Barron's
text:
By Tiernan Ray Updated May 3, 2018 6:47 p.m. ET Contrary to the hand-wringing about the high price of Apple ’s ( AAPL ) iPhone X , it turns out it was the best single phone model of last quarter, worldwide, on a unit-sales basis, according to a report this afternoon by Strategy Analytics , the market research firm.
The firm says this was the second quarter in a row it was the best-selling single model.
Apple's iPhone X Illustration: Tiernan Ray for Barron's Although the whole smartphone market was down last quarter , and pricier models like the X have been cited as a problem, Apple’s sales of the X topped all other models by all other vendors, and even Apple’s own models, with unit sales of 16 million , Strategy Analytics estimates.
Apple reported total iPhone sales of 52.2 million on Tuesday, but that includes all of the models it currently sells, such as the iPhone 8 and the older iPhone 7 and iPhone SE. The total number of iPhones was below what analysts had expected to be perhaps 53 million units for Apple in the March quarter.
The X took 5% of all smartphone sales by volume, according to Juha Winter , an analyst at Strategy Analytics. In total, Winter estimates, Apple has now sold 50 million units in the two quarters of availability.
Coming in second and third place were the iPhone 8 and the “ 8-Plus ,” with 12.5 million and 8.3 million units, respectively, the firm says. The iPhone 7 was in fourth place with 5.6 million units.
The next fastest-selling seem to lag quite a bit. Xiaomi , the privately held Chinese start-up that has filed to go public on the Hong Kong exchange, had sales of 5.4 million of its “ Redmi 5A ,” and Samsung Electronics ’ ( 005930.Korea ) “ Galaxy S9 Plus ,” introduced at the end of February, came in at sixth place with 5.3 million.
Analyst Woody Oh , however, says that the S9 is “off to a very good start."
